items.title: Silence on answer
items.body: Accepting or declining an offer now stops its ring and clears its notification straight away.

items.title: Rings when locked
items.body: Offers now ring on a locked phone and outside the app, using a fresh high priority channel.

releases.title: A clearer wait after you accept

items.title: Matching in progress
items.body: After you accept an offer, a live matching screen shows while the client makes their choice.

items.title: Simpler photographer cards
items.body: Accepted photographers now appear as clean cards with their name, speciality and distance.

items.title: One offer screen at a time
items.body: Opening an offer from the ringing screen no longer shows the same offer twice.

items.title: Offers for photographers only
items.body: Clients and event coordinators no longer see or hear photographer offers.

releases.title: Offers that ring, and photographers ranked in clear bands

items.title: New offers ring and open at once
items.body: A new event offer now rings with the Connekyt ringtone and opens straight to the offer, with a two hour countdown to accept or decline.

items.title: Accepted photographers in four bands
items.body: Clients now see who accepted grouped as Premium, Preferred, Suggested and Alternative, each card showing a score, distance, speciality and how they accepted.

items.title: Choose with confidence
items.body: Tap a photographer to confirm and pay, open their portfolio, or compare their packages and delivery policy before you decide.

items.title: Lists refresh without flickering
items.body: Opportunity and candidate lists now update quietly in the background, with no spinner, and stop completely while the app is closed.

releases.title: Watch live streams on your TV

items.title: Send a stream to your TV
items.body: On a live event, tap the TV icon at the top, pick one of your connected TVs and the stream opens on it in the Connekyt TV app. If you have no TV connected yet, the same screen takes you to connect one.

releases.title: A fuller Help Center and a roomier sign-in

items.title: Help for every part of the app
items.body: The Help Center now has step by step guides for accounts, bookings, events, live streams, wishes, photos, payments, your wallet, security and fixing problems, with search that finds the right guide.

items.title: Sign-in fits better
items.body: The sign-in form is more compact, so Find My Photos and Explore Events get more room at the top of the screen.
